'''Sar''' was a warrior from [[Shienar]]. 

== Activities ==
He was one of the twenty Shienarans picked to accompany [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]].

He wintered in the Mountains of Mist with Perrin and Rand; after Rand left and the Shienarans were abandoned to make their own way, he fell off a cliff in the [[Mountains of Mist]] and died.{{ref/book|c|Sar}}{{ref/book|5|40}}
